instrumentation: Function entry only in a separate review artifact; no production file modified
comparison: AST-equivalent bodies match independent of whitespace. Unique-name matches are candidates, not proof of semantic identity. Anonymous additions and changes are kept separate.
baselineASTMatchNote: Counts current functions whose canonical AST matches at least one baseline AST. Multiple current functions may share the same baseline body; this is not a one-to-one unchanged-function count.
